summary: This directory defines the structural schemas for analyzing TypeScript class and interface members. It provides a comprehensive framework to categorize and validate member metadata, specifically distinguishing between documentable and non-documentable properties and methods.
responsibilities: Define schemas for TypeScript class and interface member analysis
Categorize members as documentable or non-documentable
Capture metadata for property and method members including modifiers, types, and JSDoc information
Provide runtime validation schemas for member analysis objects
relationships: Member analysis is classified into either documentable or non-documentable categories based on documentation requirements.
Property and method analysis schemas act as the fundamental building blocks for both documentable and non-documentable member structures.
Base member schemas provide shared identity and visibility metadata that all specific member analyses inherit.
designDecisions: Use of Effect schemas for runtime validation and type inference
Categorization by documentation capability using discriminated unions
Composition of specific member types from base analysis definitions
